events.name: Bash
events.head: Gather T-229 commits, related task state and admin key helpers
events.input: $ git log --oneline -8 --grep='T-229' | cat; echo ---; git log --oneline -5 -- cloud/src | cat; echo ---; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read how the daily job and probe authenticate to the admin
events.input: $ sed -n 1,60p workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-220; echo ---; sed -n 1,45p app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | cut -c1-240

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the production admin key file name and the admin API routes
events.input: $ grep -n -E 'admin/enter|secret\("|async function (admin|centre)|admin\(' workshop-plan/ops/zoom_support_check.mjs | cut -c1-220 | head -20; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | head -20; grep -n -E '"(zoom|calendar|attendees)[^"]*"|zoom/(check|attendance|settings|pull)' cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the zoom, attendees and calendar admin route handlers
events.input: $ sed -n 887,960p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260; sed -n 570,580p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-260; sed -n 762,775p cloud/src/index.ts | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read production admin read-only: attendees, zoom overview, calendar, meeting checks
events.input: $ mkdir -p /tmp/t223 && cat > /tmp/t223/live.mjs <<'E'

events.text: Live production read is done (all 24 attendees are test, meeting 88135386601 checks clean, Zoom failed 0). Now confirming the deployed Worker version and running the Zoom probe on both stacks.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check deployed Worker version, unpushed cloud commits, and how probes start local stacks
events.input: $ (cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | tail -14 | cut -c1-160); echo ---; git log -1 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso -- cloud/src | cut -c1-140; git status --short cloud/src | head; git log origin/main -1 --format='origin %h' ; git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD -- cloud/src; echo ---; grep -n -i -E 'probe-zoom-pro|8896|8897|vendor-sim|wrangler dev' app/scripts/run-chain.sh | cut -c1-220 | head -20; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(88|89)[0-9]{2} ' | awk '{print $1,$9}' | sort -u | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the local stack start-up part of the chain script
events.input: $ sed -n 30,95p app/scripts/run-chain.sh | cut -c1-230

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the shared local stack ports and simulator wiring
events.input: $ lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$9}' | grep -E ':(8[0-9]{3})$' | sort -u | head -12; sed 's/=.*/=<v>/' cloud/.dev.vars | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n -E 'SIM|8792' cloud/.dev.vars | sed -E 's/(KEY|SECRET)=.*/\1=<v>/' | head; grep -rn -E 'probe-zoom-pro' --include=*.md --include=*.sh --include=*.json -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -5; grep -n -E 'SIM_PORT|argv|persist' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how earlier runs started a fresh local stack for the zoom probe
events.input: $ grep -rn -o -E '.{80}(8896|8897).{120}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-223.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-229.json 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-420 | head -6; grep -rn -E 'SIM_BASE|VENDOR_SIM|ZOOM_BASE|ZOOM_BOT_KEY' cloud/src/*.ts cloud/wrangler.* 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-200 | head -8; launchctl list | grep -i tantra | head; grep -rn -E '889[67]' app/scripts/*.sh workshop-plan/ops/*.sh cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dev centre and simulator launch agents and the Zoom base wiring
events.input: $ for n in revops-centre-dev revops-sim; do f=~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.$n.plist; echo "== $n"; [ -f $f ] && plutil -p $f | grep -v -i -E 'key|secret' | cut -c1-260 | head -25; done; grep -n -E 'sim|SIM|zoom\.us|api_base|zoom_base' cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | head -8 | cut -c1-200; grep -n -i -E 'zoom|bot|sim' app/scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | sed -n 1,400p | grep -i -E 'BOT|settings|PUT' | head -8 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dev run script and list listening ports
events.input: $ cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-240 | head -30; echo ---; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}' | sort -u | head -30; grep -n -E 'ZOOM_API|SIM_URL|sim_base|8792' cloud/src/util.ts cloud/src/calendar.ts cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/wrangler.jsonc 2>/dev/null | head -8 | cut -c1-200

events.text: Working out how the local stacks are wired so I can run the Zoom probe on both (shared stack on 8790/8792, and a fresh one on 8896/8897).

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the shared and fresh local stacks are up
events.input: $ for p in 8790 8792 8896 8897; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 4 http://127.0.0.1:$p/)"; done; tail -5 ~/Library/Logs/revops-centre-dev.log | cut -c1-200; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2 log -1 --format='%h %s' 2>&1 | cut -c1-120; ls cloud/migrations | tail -3; grep -n -E 'd1_databases|database_name|migrations_dir' cloud/wrangler.jsonc | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start a fresh local centre and simulator on 8896 and 8897
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && rm -rf /tmp/t223/state /tmp/t223/sim.json && (SIM_PORT=8897 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t223/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t223/sim.log 2>&1 &) && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply revops-centre --local --persist-to /tmp/t223/state --config wrangler.jsonc 2>&1 | tail -3 | cut -c1-160; (CI=1 WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false nohup npx wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8896 --ip 127.0.0.1 --persist-to /tmp/t223/state --var SIM_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8897 --var READER_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8897/reader/ --var PUBLIC_URL:http://127.0.0.1:8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the Zoom Pro probe on the fresh stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8896 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8897 node scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs > /tmp/t223/fresh.out 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c ^PASS /tmp/t223/fresh.out; grep -v ^PASS /tmp/t223/fresh.out | head -15 | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the failing engagement checks in the probe
events.input: $ grep -n -E 'engagement: chat|engagement: day 1|day 1 summary|tracker export carries' scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | cut -c1-120; n=$(grep -n 'engagement: chat' scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "$((n-28)),$((n+12))p" scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs | cut -c1-330; git log --oneline -6 -- scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs ../cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts ../cloud/src/zoom-engage.ts ../cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cat

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for chat and transcript ingest errors in the dev log and the code path
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -v -E ' (200|302|204) ' /tmp/t223/dev.log | grep -i -E 'error|fail|warn|✘|recording|chat|R2|bucket|exception' | cut -c1-260 | tail -20; echo ---; grep -n -E 'chat_file|CHAT|TRANSCRIPT|download_token|recfile|REC_|R2|BUCKET' cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts cloud/src/zoom-engage.ts 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-220 | head -30; ls cloud/src | grep -i zoom; grep -n 'recfile' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the recording file download code and simulator log
events.input: $ sed -n 385,410p cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | cut -c1-300; sed -n 3170,3180p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c1-200; grep -n 'zoom/rec' /tmp/t223/sim.log | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Test the simulator's recording file route directly
events.input: $ grep -n '__zoom/recfile\|__zoom/held' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c1-160; grep -c '__zoom/recfile' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2/cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py; grep -n 'recfile\|zoom/rec' /tmp/t223/sim.log | tail -6 | cut -c1-200; R=$(curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8897/__zoom/recfile -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"x.txt","content":"hello"}'); echo "$R"; U=$(echo "$R" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["url"])'); curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "$U"; curl -s -H '[redacted]' "$U" | head -c 80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how the simulator sets its own base URL
events.input: $ grep -n '^SIM_BASE\|SIM_BASE =' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -3; pgrep -fl 'vendor-sim.py' | cut -c1-160; pgrep -fl 'port 8896' | cut -c1-120

events.text: The 4 failures look like my fresh stack's wiring (the simulator hands out file links on the shared port), not a code regression. Restarting my simulator with the right base URL and rerunning.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Restart my own simulator with its own base URL and rerun the probe on the fresh stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud && for p in $(pgrep -f 'vendor-sim.py'); do if ps eww -p $p | grep -q 'SIM_PORT=8897'; then echo "mine $p"; kill $p; fi; done; sleep 1; (SIM_PORT=8897 SIM_PUBLIC=http://127.0.0.1:8897 SIM_STATE=/tmp/t223/sim.json nohup python3 scripts/vendor-sim.py > /tmp/t223/sim.log 2>&1 &); sleep 2; curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8897/__zoom/recfile -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"x.txt","content":"hello"}'; echo; cd ../app && CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8896 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8897 node scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs > /tmp/t223/fresh.out 2>&1; e

events.text: Fresh stack: 60 of 60. Now the shared stack.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the Zoom Pro probe on the shared local stack
events.input: $ CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:8790 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:8792 node scripts/probe-zoom-pro.mjs > /tmp/t223/shared.out 2>&1; echo "exit $?"; grep -c PASS /tmp/t223/shared.out; grep -E 'FAIL|Error|error' /tmp/t223/shared.out | cut -c1-220 | head -12; tail -2 /tmp/t223/shared.out | cut -c1-200
